Recorded claim:
Dashboard sections use `[data-dashboard-section]`, `<details>`/keyboard-accessible `<summary>`, `updateDashboardSectionSizes()`, and `toggle`. Empty sections close/hide their body; reopen only if they were open before becoming empty. Avoid selectors that catch nested patch-action summaries. [Task 4]
